scope: bounded read-only readiness cause review; no production edits, commits, or live actions

classification.r2: not evidenced as the actual gate reason; exact action endpoints are not bound to the rejected preparation
classification.r4: separate later lease-margin preflight exclusion; not the recorded force:0:source rejection
classification.r5: not selected; the evidence gap maps to R3/action binding

same_sample_evidence.local_state: Canonical L2 contains observed/derived own and neutral towers, typed unit vectors, deployable vectors, neighbor lists, positions, and the same document/match/player/tick identity. No action-bound source/destination pair or raw selected_tower evidence is retained.

cross_sample_preview_exclusion.reason: Different document/match from the readiness-rejection layer; cannot supply the rejected preparation's same-sample endpoint or route proof.

control_flow.global_gate: control_readiness_gaps iterates all visible towers and all observed forces; any force with unknown source adds force:<index>:source.
control_flow.execute_gate: wait_initial_readiness rejects before validate_scenario/selection when gaps remain; pre-intent execute flow also calls global readiness.
control_flow.route_semantics: A qualified before-only direct-route path certifies the pinned one-expansion A* path. gesture_continuity=UNKNOWN is an attribution/gesture gap, not a failed route certificate. This distinction cannot be applied to the rejected preparation because its action pair and certificate were not recorded.

action_local_fix.reason: The exact blocker was an Enemy force source gap, but whether that force was unrelated to the action cannot be proved without the same-sample action pair.
safe_conditions_if_reconsidered: Same snapshot and identity must bind the intended source, destination, typed units, route certificate, lifecycle, tick, and match/document continuity.
Unknown own source, own target, route legality, units, selected UI branch prerequisites, or match identity must still refuse.
Only an unknown remote Enemy endpoint proven unrelated to that action may cease blocking the action-local gate.
Keep the world-level strict readiness behavior unchanged for full-world simulation/differential claims.
negative_tests_required: remote unrelated Enemy UNKNOWN alone -> action may pass when every action-local prerequisite is known

stop: No production change or further endpoint/callback/queue/canvas/WASM/input-entry research. Stop this bounded check because R1 is not explicit.
